title: heracleum sphondylium subsp. setosum
intro: Heracleum sphondylium subsp. setosum, commonly known as wild angelica, is a perennial plant belonging to the carrot family (Apiaceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Heracleum sphondylium subsp. setosum include antioxidant, antispasmodic, and expectorant activities, making it useful in treating respiratory issues and digestive problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and lignans, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
